title: runners.toml implement cell still describes the deleted pi CLI
description:
[roles.implement] in .tick/runners.toml still explains kind = "pi" as the pi CLI (gjk's --approve trust story) and passes args = ["--approve"]. After 2q5 and uxi, kind pi in this repository only routes to the pi-durable runner through local-subprocess (or the cloud container), and neither of those reads args. The comment and the dead args mislead a reader into thinking a pi-CLI path still exists.
evidence: .tick/runners.toml [roles.implement] (comment block and args line); profiles-herdr/implement-tick.json executor local-subprocess
